items.Sentence: The Facility's secondary treatment train consists of an influent wet well, bar screens, aerated grit removal, primary clarifiers...
...bar screens, aerated grit removal, primary clarifiers, trickling filters...
...aerated grit removal, primary clarifiers, trickling filters, aerated solids contact tank...
...primary clarifiers, trickling filters, aerated solids contact tank, secondary clarifiers...
...trickling filters, aerated solids contact tank, secondary clarifiers...
...aerated solids contact tank, secondary clarifiers, and a chlorine contactor pipe where secondary disinfection is performed...
...a chlorine contactor pipe where secondary disinfection is performed using sodium hypochlorite.
The Facility's advanced treatment train includes the addition of ferric chloride and polymer to adsorption clarifiers and multi-media filters.

Advanced treated effluent is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite in the tertiary chlorine contact basin and sent to the Recycled Water Storage Ponds.
...the advanced treated effluent is dechlorinated with sodium bisulfite and discharged to the Russian River.
Biosolids generated during the treatment process are reduced through thickening in dissolved air flotation units...
Digested sludge is dewatered using a belt-filter press.

...replacement of the belt filter press with a FKC Screw Press that can operate continuously (through SCADA) that will reduce the pollutant loading of the pressate returned to the headworks after biosolids treatment.
Additional planned changes include...installation of a new Suspended Air Floatation (SAF) system for solids treatment.
